cards.snippet: Continue — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist. Continue is the open-source AI code assistant for VS Code and JetBrains, distributed under Apache 2.0. The Continue IDE extensions and the Continue CLI federate to any LLM provider — Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, OpenRouter, Ollama, and a Continue-managed proxy — a — ★ 1 | ai, apache-2-0, apis-json, artificial-intelligence, cli, code-assistant, developer-tools, jetbrains, mcp, open-source, vs-code
